notes.title: Reclaimers Launch on April 14th!
notes.content:
[h2]Prepare to play Reclaimers in less than a month!
[/h2]
The full game contains several new additions including achievements and mechanics to destroy orcs with!

[h3]Recruit[/h3]
First up is the recruiting mechanism. Add mice people to your army through recruiting. Whenever you see a house or fort, knock on the door to recruit people to your army. There are more ways to recruit mice people in the full game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/e358bcda0ab78ea7a21a9c00afd71d6454cf0ee6.png[/img]

[h3]Crafting[/h3]
Crafting has been overhauled with new UI and better functioning mechanisms. It's alot simpler to use now, with craftable recipes appearing in your sidebar. Click any item to craft it for your reclaimers to wear or wield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/4bd485a36436cb8842b59725fa1116619db94521.png[/img]

[h3]Weapons & Enemies
[/h3]
The full game also introduces many new types of orcs for you to battle. There are over 10 different orc bases you will need to raid and destroy plus over 5 orc enemies for you to face.

There are also way more weapons for you to equip to use. This includes flame throwers, lazer beams and super swords!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/0becd9399e0ee4a656d2c8b706e691a8b9cfc93d.png[/img]

[h3]Upgrade Tech Tree
[/h3]
Finally there is the Upgrade tech tree. This will make your army of mice people more lucky, stronger, and tougher against enemies they will fight in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/018b13f7dccd01219e37a880bbff1d08a5262f0d.png[/img]

Thanks for reading and see you on April 14th for launch!
Luke

notes.title: Crafting Chaos Update + Kickstarter
notes.content:
[h1]The Crafting Chaos Update[/h1]
Here is the Crafting Chaos Update. We have brought back crafting by overhauling it with better features, new weapons & armor to craft!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/92f8184d015675a77877af1da893102377f3df87.png[/img]

[h2]Crafting[/h2]
The crafting menu has been redone. It will be improved again in the final version of the game. However crafting recipes now appear when craftable. You need to collect rock, snow, sticks and sand to make all sorts of weapons and armor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/4b5bd7783fb3306a39ac1f049a7d02bfa2227a05.png[/img]

[h2]Chaotic Weapons![/h2]
Collect sticks and make spears. Which your Reclaimers will then poke these poor orcs with! Orc below had a series of unfortunate events...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/3de8391fba9708890a897a3ab0a89c650e0a5014.png[/img]

Also [h2]EXPLOSIONS!!![/h2]
That's it, just lots of explosions now...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/76d4079b71aec890042875cebc6c33746eceaef3.png[/img]


[h2]Energy Mechanic[/h2]
New feature is your classic tech tree for your Reclaimers organs. You can now use the energy from harvesting berries to make your Reclaimers stronger, tougher and apparently giant sized?!?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/d3511979fc8dfd0c913f27dd04e4a084e64c178b.png[/img]


And finally!

[h1]Our New Kickstarter![/h1]
Launching on February 1st is our Kickstarter Fundraiser! Go follow our page to build the hype:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lnoyoutuber/help-purge-the-programmer-art-reclaimers-steam-game 

We are going to be purging all the programmer art from the game! As you know I am a solo game developer - who also cannot draw for his life - since I am your stereotypial programmer (;

Below is some of the art you can help destroy and remove from Reclaimers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/fec6b34de7a6f343da5000c767e11b14c6ccab19.png[/img]

Cheers & thanks for the support!
Luke

notes.title: Version 0.6 Update! The Troll Level Is Impossible!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Our latest update involves all things Reclaiming! 

There is now a level system where you work your way through conquering and hopping between different islands. Reaching new levels you will come across new biomes, harder enemy's and more loot!

[h1]Level 1 - Grass Lands[/h1]
The tutorial level will have you fight the orc stronghold located on the island. Your objective is to capture the flag and take control of the island. Recruit an army, crush the orcs and take the boat to the next island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/d9a181b9b4ece77eb5e4826788b6641fcb187dcb.png[/img]

[h1]Level 2 - Forest Island[/h1]
You have crashed landed on the next island, this time a slightly bigger island with forests. Similar to last time, you have to crush three orc camps to reclaim the island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/1545fe3338496fdf35485fef332845627439e09d.png[/img]

[h1]Level 3 - Troll Territory[/h1]
Reach the heights of the troll island, where mountain ranges hold dangers that are far more dangerous... 

I'm not going to lie, noone can currently get past this level... Pretty sure it's because the troll is one of the most toughest enemies in the game and your army of reclaimers have no way to get any decent loot at this point of the game (will be fixed soon - don't worry!). 

Till that is fixed you'll have to brute force your way to victory against the troll on his island!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/936c6c4976ddc409828d549a330042181cb4a924.png[/img]

[h1]Level 4 - Purple Head Monsters...[/h1]
This island you will have to come up against... uhh... how do you describe this guys?!?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/078a94c0d4e1a6d757f32041e4af292e39f7480d.png[/img]

Yeah the purple head monsters will be roaming this island. Take control of the island to move on while avoiding these guys! Plus you get access to sand and snow biomes!

[h1]Level 5 - ???[/h1]
If you can make it here, well done, I wish you luck with the finale! I won't spoil anything here (;

[h1]Final words[/h1]
As always, gameplay has been improved, bugs have been removed and the game is evergrowing with purpose and fun gaming!

Some more major changes:
[list]
[*]Movement has been overhauled, it's so much cleaner now haha!
[*]Trolls can now jump... Run away!
[*]Orcs now have a leader, and once that leader dies they will try to flee!
[/list]

We have currently removed crafting as play testing has revealed it was too difficult to play with. But don't worry we are currently working on a crafting overhaul update so stay tuned!

Thanks for the support as always!
Luke

notes.title: Reclaimers is officially an Open World Survival Craft!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have Version 0.5 The Crafting Update Out for Release Today! And Happy Steam Next Fest (for those who have come from that). 

Here is what you can now play with the new Update:

[h2]Inventory[/h2]
As you can see from the picture below, your inventory is based on the amount of people you have. Each person can hold one item. So if you have 20 people, you can carry only 20 items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/5a8618cdeac2855934b100f9a25fffd4d38d5d58.png[/img]

[h2]Resources[/h2]

Around our open world, procedurally generated map we have resources spawning in specific biomes everywhere. Here's all the resources:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/c7dd72848dcb79d4f02b94bfde3a6be0659755fe.png[/img]

Your reclaimers can mine these resources if they have the required tool available. You can craft these from the crafting system. By default you will be able to collect logs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/1188c90bce8831982373185695fa0fec5ef4cf0a.png[/img]

[h2]Crafting System[/h2]

Now onto the crafting. Everything is procedurally generated, which means the required resources to make tools will always be different. 
Plus the tool you will get in the early stages of the game compared to late game gear will change randomly as well. 

The overall idea is to make each play through of the game as different and interesting as possible, as you will most likely be dying alot!

To get going click the hammer or press 'R' to open up the shop:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/41beab0b634235e723b595fb03a3ce15b1cad3da.png[/img]

Then you will be able to see what you can craft and what resources you will need to gather.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/3be04b251317fc1321a475727202ef381efe4f14.png[/img]

[h2]More To Come![/h2]
And that's it!

Thanks for reading this latest Update!
More versions are coming so please wishlist the game and expect to see more updates in the following months!

GG, Luke

notes.title: World Procedural Generation Update!
notes.content:
G'day everyone!

Brand new World Procedural Generation Update has been released on our Demo. Go try it out!  

You are now on one giant island to go explore and adventure around. Obviously the limit to the world is the ocean border of the island. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/6dadd54b43340f609e7b79eb0c9fd019a5d790e5.png[/img]

[b]Here's some pictures of the current biomes available to explore:
[/b]
Forest Biome 
[list]
[*] Mainly trees lol
[*] Birds can only be found in Forest Biomes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/7cf6a6624bee7af4a3a2f45a0b1d6b91e71d7e7d.png[/img]

Snow Biome
[list]
[*] Has Orc Camps and Berry Bushes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/4358c8ac10e1cfdc4342a8483f1fdad860b2f3c9.png[/img]

Mountain Biome
[list]
[*] Trolls have been limited to Mountain Biomes
[*] Orc Camps can also spawn in Mountain Biomes
[*] Loot is only found in these biomes. While hostile, it is worth exploring to find some weapons for your Reclaimers!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/d6306431634b47bde7b07037e5af23576af0ac17.png[/img]

Plains Biome
[list]
[*] VIllages spawn here. Come here to recruit new members to your Reclaimer army!
[*] Bushes and some trees spawn in this Biome
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43108416/b23c001f82a2e40d2ca93fc907e6e4dc876320fe.png[/img]

[b]Some FYI's:[/b]
[list]
[*] We currently intend to release this game in early 2025. 
[*] We plan to begin to start releasing new regular updates every few weeks so keep an eye out for new and exciting features
[*] It takes like a minute to load the game. This is due to inefficent world spawning. We intend to make loading time a thing of the past!
[*] Please give feedback! We are looking out for any ideas to include in the game (:
[/list]

We are going to add alot more stuff to the game, including base building, actual game progression, bosses, proper orc outposts and more!

Hope you're as excited as I am, see you all next time!
Luke
